items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Heisenbaum' in a list of musicians/bands, and the interviewee does not confirm any personal interaction or relationship, only acknowledging the name in the flow of conversation.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I used to play with Tronman.

Oh, yeah. Eddie Jackson. I played with his band, too. The Nola band. The Nola band. Yeah. The Nola band. I played with the Nola band. You remember that. You played. You played with the band. Yeah. Eddie Jackson, Peter La Caz. And who had, I don't know what was it, Paul's band? Or, what? Heisenbaum. Heisenbaum.
